issues.detail: Monthly and site spend substitute 0 for nullable total_due (69,89); an entirely unpriced month/site becomes a numeric zero. Partial duration sums missing/invalid durations as 0 (147) without missing-count context. Numeric sorts also equate missing energy/cost with recorded zero (317,320). Row-level null displays are correctly distinct.
issues.fix: Preserve recorded zero and signed known amounts; keep absent facts unknown and expose recorded subtotal/missing counts for partial aggregates. Use a deliberate missing-value sort order. Do not invent complete totals.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Carry forward audit-page-089 unknown-evidence root; refreshed current citations, not a Phase0 rerun.

issues.detail: Local month/site sums discard currency_code and are formatted with the saved symbol, without FX conversion. For missing row currency, currencyCodeFromSymbol guesses an ISO code from a preference (105,234). Thus source denomination can be relabeled or heterogeneous bills combined. This is a frontend mechanism, not a claim that real history contains mixed currencies.
issues.fix: Keep per-currency/unknown-denomination evidence and avoid guessed FX or ISO identity. Reuse existing currency formatting with established source codes; retain all rows and signed amounts. Server summary/ranking normalization requires separate evidence.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Existing audit-page-089 local currency root, now source-confirmed formatter boundary; server normalization stays candidate.

issues.detail: The table exportRow provides currency and pricing_type, but DataTable serializes only visible column keys; neither is a column, so standard CSV/JSON loses denomination/pricing metadata while exporting raw cost/rate. Dedicated selected CSV includes them, but replaces commas/quotes/newlines in the location value with spaces (354), irreversibly altering source text despite later CSV escaping.
issues.fix: Preserve both export actions/scopes and source values; provide an explicit export schema/mapping that includes denomination/pricing metadata, and quote CSV without altering location text. Prefer the existing controller only with exact schema parity.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Refines audit-page-089 export/schema divergence; one preservation root with two concrete serializer effects, not duplicate export tasks.

issues.detail: Price Radar uses isError to replace its rows even when the independent ranking query retains data. It has no retained-refresh warning or paused/unavailable distinction. The historical source correctly uses fatalError and retains its own sections, so these sources have inconsistent trust handling.
issues.fix: Adapt the existing ranking query through useDataState and existing retained/paused notices. Replace only fatal no-data content and keep its independent retry and neighbors.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Exact remaining Price Radar trust root already described in audit-page-089; no separate global trust engine.

issues.detail: History and ranking read APIs accept VIN/enabled only; their query keys and URLs omit both workspace instants. Page filtering affects only returned history rows, while Price Radar is unbounded and the server summary stays lifetime. Precise local exclusive bounds and the KPI scope explanation are present, but they do not establish complete bounded server results.
issues.fix: Continue the existing G090/G094 integration requirement: first establish backend supported names, exclusive bound semantics, ordering and completeness. Then separately lease typed hook/caller integration if needed. Preserve distinct lifetime summary and loaded-row scopes; never guess endpoint parameters or totals.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Existing inventory G090/G094 requirement; no fresh global API proposal and no alleged real-data truncation.

issues.detail: History refresh POST omits requiresLiveMode. request() defaults that flag false and operationalMode skips refusal when it is false; this path is not covered by offline unsafe patterns. The page checks history fetch pause/pending, not as_of mode. In an online historical/as_of view the source path has no live-only request guard. No POST was run.
issues.fix: Opt this exact mutation into the existing live-mode request guard and align page disabled/explanatory behavior with the existing operational-mode owner. Preserve manual sync, optional VIN/bounds, real outcomes and success-only invalidation; no offline queue.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: New exact guard manifestation; advanced causal live-guard work has different source claims and does not cover useCharging.

issues.detail: formatDurationMinutes emits literal h/m suffixes with unlocalized numeric interpolation at 56-57. It is used in table cells, mobile values and the duration KPI. One localization root, two literal template sites; these are authored display units, not backend identifiers.
issues.fix: Reuse existing localized duration/number formatting while preserving positive-duration rounding and hour/minute information. Request only proven missing canonical copy under a separate catalog lease, if needed.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Exact existing audit-page-089 duration localization root; canonical catalog presence was not inspected.

issues.detail: Table dates, mobile dates, selection labels and Last synced call the pure formatDateTime without opts, selecting browser locale/timezone rather than saved settings. Price Radar renders last_visit as the raw source string. Existing useDateFormat already binds saved locale and timezone; no such binding reaches these displays.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing preference-bound formatter for displayed instants and source date labels, preserving UTC export timestamps and existing range semantics. Do not silently redefine monthly bucket timezone or invent 12/24h support beyond the formatter API.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Newly traced current display boundary; advanced evidence-date item queue:334 owns different files and is not an exact duplicate.

issues.detail: Price Radar renders Lucide BadgePercent directly at 29 and 40 rather than through the existing Icon owner. Its title glyph also uses fixed cyan-300 instead of the restrained role. Named route-local Lucide imports are acceptable; the rendered boundary is the issue. No contrast failure is claimed.
issues.fix: Render these same glyphs through existing Icon with semantic sizes and neutral/appropriate role styling; preserve title, empty state and meaning. No new icon family or shared component.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Remaining direct-part presentation root; page glyphs and single solid chart hue are already adopted.

issues.detail: The sessions panel uses entries.length===0 after range filtering, but its hasData message says no Tesla history yet and asks to import. With existing allEntries outside the chosen range this describes no records instead of no matches in the window. The separate search-no-match message is correct.
issues.fix: Distinguish authoritative lifetime-empty, range-empty, search-empty and unavailable; keep the sessions shell visible and expose an appropriate scope recovery action without forcing a sync.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: New exact range-empty manifestation; no new generic empty-state component.

issues.detail: Ranking rows are sliced to the first eight (23). The spread then compares first and last of that slice but labels the last as priciest without saying displayed subset. For a cheapest-first source with more than eight sites, that is not the priciest source site. Completeness of any real response is untested.
issues.fix: Keep the eight-row presentation; calculate an all-source comparison only if its source scope is established, or label the spread explicitly as among displayed sites. Retain unpriced counts and source ordering.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: Prior audit records spread within eight, not corrected unqualified wording; one exact domain-copy/calculation need.

issues.detail: Only vehicle isLoading is consumed. An initial fleet-query failure finishes loading but leaves vehicle/VIN unresolved; history and radar still enable, and undefined VIN means fleet-wide request. A persisted or URL vehicle selection can therefore become an implicit fleet request without a vehicle-source error/retry. Explicit vin=* fleet selection is valid and must remain separate.
issues.fix: Carry vehicle query trust and explicit fleet-versus-unresolved scope into enablement and visible prerequisite feedback. Preserve valid VIN bookmark promotion, deliberate fleet mode and retained usable vehicle scope; do not broaden on prerequisite failure.
issues.priorAuditRelationship: New prerequisite failure mechanism at existing VIN owner; this is not authorization/privacy bypass proof.

candidates.detail: No limit/offset/total/exhaustion contract is available in this hook. Whether entries contain all local records, summary normalizes currency, or ranking ordering is guaranteed requires backend evidence; router wiring alone proves none of these. No real history accessed.

Last synced comes from first range-filtered entry, so the label can change/disappear with the window. No source-global timestamp/ordering/fetched_at semantics were established. Keep row metadata; do not promote it to global freshness without integration evidence.

Signed known bills survive arithmetic/currency text/export, but MetricBar.tsx:53-62 clamps negative numeric/ARIA progress to zero. If valid credits reach a ranked site, visible negative amount and aria-valuenow=0 conflict. Reachability/domain credit policy and composed assistive output NOTRUN; preserve physical sign, do not clamp source money.

Invoice href is same-origin /api/v1 and bypasses apiUrl base/demo routing (client.ts:88-92). Encoding and new-tab protections are present; remote/native/download authentication behavior NOTRUN. Not a double-prefix request violation.

rate_base is displayed with pricing_type or kWh, but source currency/unit/pricing denominator guarantees were not verified. Wh energy stays raw on hook/cache/export and converts only at display; no guessed rate-unit conversion is authorized.

Month buckets use browser getFullYear/getMonth and YYYY-MM labels; chart fill is chartTokens.series[0]. Intended bucket timezone and effective saved chart preference behavior require the existing chart/range owners, not a local palette or silently rebucketed totals.

Price Radar truncates long labels and keeps price shrink-0; actual overflow, full visual text reachability, focus, RTL, 200% text, composed contrast, forced colors, touch targets and screen-reader output are unmeasured. Mobile adapter source includes all-column invoice details; no device acceptance inferred.
